name: gizza-ai/urdu-romanizer
summary: Transliterate Urdu script into Roman Urdu

tool.description: Transliterate Urdu script into Roman (Latin) Urdu locally. Choose informal ASCII Roman Urdu, ALA-LC or ISO 15919 schemes; control short-vowel handling, common-word spellings, digit conversion, punctuation conversion and capitalization. The converter is deterministic and preserves line breaks, emoji and existing Latin text.

capitalization.description: Capitalization for Roman output: lowercase/no change, sentence-case after punctuation and line breaks, or title-case each word.

common_words.description: Use a small built-in list of common Urdu words for conventional informal spellings such as ہے → hai and پاکستان → pakistan. Applies only to the informal scheme.

digits.description: Convert Urdu and Arabic-Indic digits to ASCII 0-9, or keep digit characters exactly as typed.

input.description: Urdu script text to transliterate into Roman (Latin) Urdu. Paragraphs, punctuation, emoji and existing Latin text are preserved.

punctuation.description: Convert Urdu punctuation such as ۔ ، ؟ ؛ ٪ to Latin punctuation, or preserve the original punctuation characters.

scheme.description: Romanization scheme. informal is plain ASCII Roman Urdu; ala-lc and iso15919 keep more Arabic-letter distinctions with diacritics.

short_vowels.description: How to handle unwritten short vowels: insert-a adds a pronounceable default between consonants, marks-only honours only typed vowel marks, omit drops all short-vowel marks.
